title: Puzzle2d Label Color On Selection
description: Labels on puzzle2d sometimes keep stale primary/secondary colors after selection changes; zoom forces correct repaint. Fix text overlay dirty detection to include selection/preselect chrome.
summary: Fixed stale puzzle2d label colors after selection: textOverlayDirty() recorded selection/preselect in rememberTextOverlayPainted() but never compared them, so paintTextOverlays() skipped repaints until camera zoom bumped viewport state. Now selection/preselect chrome always marks the overlay dirty; camera/viewport/LOD stays deferred during wheelZoomGestureActive. Added tests for selection dirty/repaint and selection repaint mid wheel-zoom.
